turns.text: The wrist felt absolutely perfect! No pain at all, which is a massive relief. It was so nice to focus on my grip and footwork on the bouldering routes without worrying about it.

turns.text: Strictly a workout today, though the architecture of the building is actually pretty striking. I might have to bring my camera next time. Chicago has some really cool repurposed industrial spaces like that.

turns.text: It really does, there's so much great texture to capture here. Have you and Leah figured out what you're doing for dinner tonight after all that physical effort?

turns.text: We have! I'm actually about to start prepping. I'm going to assemble some seasoned fillings and fold them into warm corn tortillas with plenty of cilantro, lime, and fresh salsa.
